content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Davangere University Guest Faculty / Teaching Assistants Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.davangereuniversity.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 08-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Davangere University for hiring temporary academic staff in the English department language lab for the academic year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. What posts are available under this notification?
faq.answer: The notification invites applications for Guest Faculty and Teaching Assistants positions under advertisement number DAVANI/MASANI/190/2026-27.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled application form along with required documents and fee details is 08-10-2026 by 4:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for Davangere University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates must download the form, fill it, and send it by post or hand to the concerned department head.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for SC, ST, and Cat-1 category candidates is Rs. 500, payable via Demand Draft or Challan.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for other categories?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to other categories are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 1000 through the specified payment mode.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D., NET, SLET, or SET qualification as per UGC norms to be eligible for the Guest Faculty and Teaching Assistant positions.

faq.question: Q8. Where should I send the completed application form?
faq.answer: The application form must be submitted to the Concerned Department Head / Coordinator, Davangere University, Shivagangotri, Davangere - 577007.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Guest Faculty and Teaching Assistant posts will be based strictly on an interview conducted at the university.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download both the official notification PDF and the application form directly from the official Davangere University website at www.davangereuniversity.ac.in.
